name: Plakar
tagline: Effortless open source backup platform
description: Plakar is an open-source backup and restore solution designed to simplify data protection for businesses of all sizes. It protects anything—from local files to multi-cloud AI pipelines—while keeping every snapshot lean, encrypted, and instantly recoverable.
detailed_description: Plakar is an open-source backup platform designed to simplify data protection for engineers and organizations. It offers a snapshot-based approach, allowing users to capture data states and record changes efficiently. Plakar is built on top of the Kloset immutable data store, providing features like efficient deduplication, portable archives, and flexible storage backends. It solves the problem of complex legacy backup solutions by offering a simple command-line interface and end-to-end encryption. Plakar supports a wide range of data sources, from local files to multi-cloud AI pipelines, ensuring that backups are lean, encrypted, and instantly recoverable. It also includes alerting for suspicious activity and supports massive data volumes with minimal RAM usage. Overall, Plakar aims to redefine open-source data protection with its ease of use and robust security features.
features: Efficient Deduplication: Plakar uses advanced deduplication algorithms to reduce storage costs by eliminating duplicate data, allowing users to increase restore points without increasing costs.
Portable Archives (.ptar): Users can package full repositories or slices into single, deduplicated, optionally encrypted files that can be cloned, synced, diffed, or mounted anywhere.
Flexible Storage Backends: Plakar supports writing backups to various storage options such as local disks, SQLite, S3 buckets, SFTP servers, and more with a single command.
Built-in Encryption: Plakar protects backups with end-to-end encryption using audited algorithms, ensuring data safety both in transit and at rest.
Snapshot Simplicity: It offers a simple snapshot model that captures data states and records changes efficiently, making it easy to browse past versions of data.

name: OpenMemory MCP
tagline: Your private, local memory layer for all AI tools
description: OpenMemory MCP is a private, local-first memory layer with a built-in UI, compatible with all MCP-clients. It ensures all memory stays local, structured, and under your control with no cloud sync or external storage.
detailed_description: OpenMemory MCP is a private, local-first memory server designed to create a shared, persistent memory layer for MCP-compatible AI tools. It allows users to store and manage AI interaction content locally, ensuring data privacy and control. The main purpose of OpenMemory MCP is to provide a unified memory layer that stays with the user, enabling seamless context handoff across different AI tools. This solves the problem of AI tools needing repeated instructions due to lack of memory persistence. By using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenMemory MCP facilitates context-aware memory management across tools like Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf. It runs entirely on the user's machine, with no cloud sync or external storage required. This approach enhances AI workflow efficiency by maintaining a single set of memory content across tools.
features: Unified Local Storage: Stores all AI interaction content locally on the user's device, ensuring data privacy and control. This feature allows users to maintain full control over their data without relying on cloud services.

Cross-Tool Memory Sharing: Enables seamless access to the same memory repository for MCP-compatible clients, eliminating the need for repeated context input. This feature enhances workflow efficiency by allowing AI tools to access relevant memories across sessions.

Relevance-Based Retrieval: Uses a vector store (Qdrant) to perform relevance-based retrieval of memories, not just keyword matching. This feature improves the accuracy of memory recall by considering the context and relevance of the stored information.

Access Control and Auditing: Allows users to pause or revoke client access at the app or memory level, with audit logs for every read or write operation. This feature enhances security and compliance by providing a clear record of all interactions with the memory layer.

Visualization Dashboard: Provides a centralized management interface for adding, browsing, deleting memories, and controlling client access permissions. This feature simplifies the management of AI memories by offering a user-friendly interface for monitoring and adjusting memory access.

Project Planning: In project planning scenarios, OpenMemory MCP helps AI tools recall important project details and decisions made during previous sessions. This enhances collaboration and reduces errors by maintaining a consistent memory across tools.

AI Workflow Automation: OpenMemory MCP can be used to automate AI workflows by enabling tools to access and build upon previous interactions. This improves efficiency by reducing the need for manual input and ensuring that AI tools can learn from past experiences.
target_audience: OpenMemory MCP is designed for individuals and organizations that use multiple AI tools and require a unified memory layer to enhance workflow efficiency.
